# FocalRuta — SOTA dual release

- `index.html`: hosted/PWA target; lean HTML, external CSS/data and granular lazy WebP diagrams.
- `FocalRuta_STANDALONE.html`: single-file iPhone/offline attachment target.
- `field_card.html`: quick operational card.
- `plans/`: individual self-contained plan pages.
- `diagrams-webp/`: hosted diagram assets.
- `sw.js`: versioned shell/runtime cache.
- `.github/workflows/pages.yml`: GitHub Pages workflow.
